messages:
Riley: Heads up — Newbridge put the POC on hold. Board wants exec bridge. Blockers: SAML + IP allowlist, pilot pricing cap, SOC2+KMS clarifications. Can we triage?
Diego: Tech: they need SAML metadata (IdP) and websocket egress CIDRs. We can provide 44.55.66.0/24 and 13.52.0.0/16 for hosted, will confirm. We don't support mTLS on Hosted.
Mei: Security: BYO-KMS only on Private. For Hosted we offer cloud KMS integrations but keys remain provider-managed. They also asked for SOC2 Type II summary and pen-test highlights.
Harrison: Commercial: customer asking 60% pilot discount + conversion guarantee. Finance caps pilot discounts at 30% without CRO approval. Suggest offering 30% + $10k credits; escalate to CRO for anything larger.
legal-bot: Reminder: SOC2 and pen-test docs require NDA + DPA before sharing. Templates available — Legal can fast-track a DPA if needed.
Diego: Quick SAML template sent to them. Also sending recommended IP ranges. Note: if they use private peering we'll provide different internal ranges.
Riley: Action items: 1) Riley -> schedule exec bridge (ETA 45m). 2) Diego -> confirm CIDRs+SAML (ETA 1h). 3) Mei -> prepare SOC2 summary + BYO-KMS one-pager (ETA EOD). 4) Harrison -> pricing fallback slide and CRO escalation (ETA 2h). 5) Legal -> push NDA+DPA template (ETA 3h).
infra-bot: Calendar event created: "Newbridge exec bridge" — tomorrow 09:00 PT. Organizer: Riley.
Harrison: I'll prep finance justification for 30%+credits and draft conversion ARR thresholds.
Riley: If we can get DPA and CIDRs before the bridge we can answer infra questions live. I'll DM CRO and GC now. :rocket:
